title: Lillian H Probable NDE 4685
content: During sex, I suddenly felt as if an axe had been put into my head, and the pain would not stop. I made it 5 feet to the bathroom, where I immediately vomited and lost control of my urinary tract and bowel. I told my partner to leave as I was sick and wanted to be alone. My partner left and I flopped onto the bed. As I lay on my bed after my partner left, I went into a state of pain beyond pain and into a dark place. It became a deep blue, then a turquoise blue, then a pale blue. It changed to a dark white, then to a brighter white, and then to a white like a welding torch. I could feel my body going upward as this happened. I was then standing and saw the beautiful sight of a man who was sitting on a rock. He had a beard and a tunic. This man was talking with little babies who were standing around him and they understood him. Then I saw my grandfather. As he came toward me, a lady in a clear soft blue flowing gown stepped between us, saying, 'She has not yet done her assignment and has to go back.' My grandfather said, 'We will be here for you Lillian.' I felt her touch my wrist and I was back to the entrance of the torch bright light. That was Friday night. I never saw Saturday. On Sunday, around noon, a neighbor woke me up and took me to the drugstore for medication, as I thought it was a flu bug. I pushed the car out of a ditch of snow and went home to sleep until Monday morning for work. I then went to work and remember walking into a waste basket, after which I kept walking. Later I decided to go to the doctor and was taken from there to the hospital by ambulance. I had a brain operation within minutes of arrival at the hospital. That was Feb 02 1993. Two days later, I had a second operation for a subdural hematoma brain bleed.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Entered a dark place that shifted through deep blue/turquoise/pale blue, then dark white to brighter white, then 'a white like a welding torch.'
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Felt her body 'going upward' as the colors/light changed.

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw 'a man who was sitting on a rock' with 'a beard and a tunic' talking with 'little babies' who understood him; also a 'lady in a clear soft blue flowing gown.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Rock where the man was sitting; dominant feature was increasingly bright white light 'like a welding torch' after color transitions.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told she had 'not yet done her assignment and has to go back.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sudden severe head pain during sex; later required emergency brain surgery and a second operation for subdural hematoma/brain bleed.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Color-to-light transition (dark place to blues to whites to 'welding torch' white) with upward movement; encounter with babies and a bearded man in a tunic; return triggered by wrist touch.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Dark/color/light transition with upward movement preceded the encounter scene; no explicit OBE scene of viewing the physical room/body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Saw a seated bearded man in a tunic talking with 'little babies' who understood him; return initiated by a lady touching her wrist and placing her back at the entrance of the torch-bright light.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'She has not yet done her assignment and has to go back.'; 'We will be here for you Lillian.'; 'a white like a welding torch.'
